system.description:
As a Swift Action, you can use your Wan-Shen to parry your opponents' attacks, gaining a +1 deflection bonus to your Reflex Defense against melee attacks until the start of your next turn. You must have your Wan-Shen in hand to use this Talent, and you do not gain the deflection bonus if you are Flat-Footed or otherwise unaware of the incoming attack.

You can take this Talent multiple times; each time you take this Talent, the deflection bonus increases by +1 (to a maximum of +3).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual
